mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the service hatch was most worthwhile: it showed how to preserve access to the controller and counterweight without spoiling the whale’s shape.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempts to fit the skin and stop extension were frustrating because their required order was not apparent from the parts.

surprise.text: I expected the skin to go on first, but the frame needed its module mount and lift module before it could be covered.

arbitrary.text: The exact fitting order initially felt arbitrary; inspection revealed what was allowed, though not why the skin had to wait.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the accessible hatch and outside stop make me curious how the assembled whale will be tested, though I hope the next ordering is clearer.
